meta.title: An attachment from another company's storage is refused
gaps: what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed).

plan.title: An attachment from another company's storage is refused

assert.say: the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed)

expected.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
